entities.name: Fidel Ángel Castro Díaz-Balart
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Fidel Ángel Castro Díaz-Balart was a Cuban nuclear physicist and government official. Frequently known by the diminutive 
Fidelito, he was the eldest son of Cuban leader Fidel Castro and his first wife, Mirta Díaz-Balart.
